_deployment: Provision one model and one hardware/TP shape through site automation, then bind its running engines here.
_engines: List every vLLM endpoint. Each engine runs NixlConnector with kv_role kv_both. role sets the opening pool; pin fixes that role.
_slo: Set both budgets from profiles measured on this engine shape. TPOT exceeds the fitted zero-contention intercept.
_engine: Run narwhal-check --calibrate-first-token for the served input range. Set first_token_timeout_s above its candidate and first_token_calibration_path to the completed artifact under runs/. An empty path reports an uncalibrated warning.
_continuation: Continuation is disabled. Enabling it requires explicit attempt, credit, context and history bounds, plus a private qualification record and its SHA-256 digest. Requests must also opt in with narwhal_continuation.
